sources.title: Intern-Decision-2B: Local VRAM and Hardware Fit
sources.snippet: InternLM's mid-size open decision model, fine-tuned from Qwen3.5-2B with the vision tower kept frozen. It answers several typed Choice, Score and Noul questions about text and images in one forward pass and returns calibrated probabilities.

sources.title: Intern-Decision - a Hugging Face Space by internlm
sources.snippet: Upload up to eight images and optionally describe the situation, then enter your questions and answer options in a simple JSON format. The tool quickly returns the probability for each option, help...
